panels.description: 选定时间范围内的总行驶里程

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(convert_km((max(end_km) - min(start_km))::numeric, '$length_unit'),0)|| ' $length_unit' as "行驶里程"
FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
select sum(effective_cost(id, cost)) as "充电总费用" FROM charging_processes where $__timeFilter(start_date) AND car_id = $car_id;

SELECT
	sum(charge_energy_added) as "充电总量",
	SUM(greatest(charge_energy_added, charge_energy_used)) AS "用电总量",
	SUM(charge_energy_added) * 100 / SUM(greatest(charge_energy_added, charge_energy_used)) AS "充电效率"
FROM charging_processes
WHERE
	car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) AND charge_energy_added > 0.01

panels.description: 所选时间范围内，该车行程起终点或充电所在的国家数与城市/区县数。国内地址的城市名来自地图服务，常常是区县一级，比如深圳的宝安区、福田区会分开列出。

targets.rawSql:
WITH visits AS (
  SELECT v.address_id, v.ts
  FROM drives d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.start_address_id, d.start_date),
                             (d.end_address_id,   d.end_date)) AS v(address_id, ts)
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp.address_id, cp.start_date
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date)
), places AS (
  SELECT a.country AS country_name,
         COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood) AS "City",
         COALESCE(NULLIF(a.state_district, ''), NULLIF(a.state, ''), '') AS region_name,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(a.raw #>> '{address,country_code}'), ''), 'name:' || lower(a.country)) AS country_code,
         a.latitude,
         a.longitude,
         v.ts AS visit,
         (timezone('UTC', v.ts) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')::date AS local_day
  FROM visits v
  JOIN addresses a ON a.id = v.address_id
  WHERE a.country IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood) IS NOT NULL
), normalized_places AS (
  SELECT country_code,
         min(country_name) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code) AS "Country",
         "City",
         region_name AS "Region",
         latitude,
         longitude,
         visit,
         local_day
  FROM places
), stats AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT country_code) AS "Countries",
         count(DISTINCT (country_code, "City", "Region")) AS "Cities",
         min(visit) AS "From",
         max(visit) AS "To",
         count(DISTINCT local_day) AS "Days"
  FROM normalized_places
)
SELECT normalized_places.*,
       jsonb_build_array(country_code, "City", "Region")::text AS city_key,
       stats."Countries",
       stats."Cities",
       stats."From",
       stats."To",
       stats."Days"
FROM normalized_places
CROSS JOIN stats

WITH sample_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT MIN(p.id) AS id
  FROM positions p
  WHERE p.car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(p.date)
    AND p.drive_id IS NOT NULL
    AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.drive_id, date_trunc('minute', p.date)
),
sampled AS (
  SELECT
    p.id::text AS id,
    p.drive_id,
    p.date,
    p.latitude,
    p.longitude
  FROM sample_ids s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.id, p.drive_id, p.date, p.latitude, p.longitude
    FROM positions p
    WHERE p.id = s.id
    OFFSET 0
  ) p
)
SELECT
  id,
  lat_for_map('${map_url}', latitude, longitude) AS latitude,
  lng_for_map('${map_url}', latitude, longitude) AS longitude
FROM sampled
ORDER BY date

WITH sample_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT MIN(p.id) AS id
  FROM positions p
  WHERE p.car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(p.date)
    AND p.drive_id IS NOT NULL
    AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.drive_id, date_trunc('minute', p.date)
),
sampled AS (
  SELECT
    p.id::text AS id,
    p.drive_id,
    p.date,
    p.latitude,
    p.longitude
  FROM sample_ids s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.id, p.drive_id, p.date, p.latitude, p.longitude
    FROM positions p
    WHERE p.id = s.id
    OFFSET 0
  ) p
),
linked AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    drive_id,
    date,
    LEAD(id) OVER (PARTITION BY drive_id ORDER BY date) AS next_id,
    LEAD(date) OVER (PARTITION BY drive_id ORDER BY date) AS next_date
  FROM sampled
)
SELECT
  id || '->' || next_id AS id,
  id AS source,
  next_id AS target
FROM linked
WHERE next_id IS NOT NULL
  AND next_date - date <= interval '5 minutes'
ORDER BY date

WITH visits AS (
  SELECT v.address_id, v.ts
  FROM drives d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.start_address_id, d.start_date),
                             (d.end_address_id,   d.end_date)) AS v(address_id, ts)
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp.address_id, cp.start_date
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date)
), places AS (
  SELECT a.country AS country_name,
         COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood) AS "City",
         COALESCE(NULLIF(a.state_district, ''), NULLIF(a.state, ''), '') AS "Region",
         COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(a.raw #>> '{address,country_code}'), ''), 'name:' || lower(a.country)) AS country_code,
         a.latitude,
         a.longitude,
         v.ts AS visit,
         (timezone('UTC', v.ts) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')::date AS local_day
  FROM visits v
  JOIN addresses a ON a.id = v.address_id
  WHERE a.country IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood) IS NOT NULL
), normalized_places AS (
  SELECT country_code,
         min(country_name) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code) AS "Country",
         "City",
         "Region",
         latitude,
         longitude,
         visit,
         local_day
  FROM places
)
SELECT country_code,
       "Country",
       "City",
       "Region",
       min(visit) AS "First visit",
       max(visit) AS "Last visit",
       count(DISTINCT local_day) AS "Days",
       lat_for_map('${map_url}', avg(latitude)::float, avg(longitude)::float) AS latitude,
       lng_for_map('${map_url}', avg(latitude)::float, avg(longitude)::float) AS longitude
FROM normalized_places
GROUP BY country_code, "Country", "City", "Region"

panels.title: 行驶轨迹
panels.description: 蓝线：所选时间范围内的行驶轨迹。橙点：行程起终点或充电所在的城市或区县，悬停查看日期，点名称查看在该城市的每一天。
点击名称，列出在那里的每一天。国内地址的城市名来自地图服务，常常是区县一级，比如深圳的宝安区、福田区会分开列出。
panels.title: 城市 / 区县

panels.description: 在「城市 / 区县」表或地图上点选地点后，这里列出该车在那里的每一天。点击日期打开当天的行程。

targets.rawSql:
WITH addr AS (
  SELECT id, name, road, house_number, display_name
  FROM addresses
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(raw #>> '{address,country_code}'), ''), 'name:' || lower(country)) = ${country_code:sqlstring}
    AND COALESCE(city, neighbourhood) = ${city:sqlstring}
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(state_district, ''), NULLIF(state, ''), '') = ${region:sqlstring}
), visits AS (
  SELECT 'drive' AS kind, d.id AS ref_id, d.start_date AS ts, d.start_address_id AS address_id
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.car_id = NULLIF(${selected_car_id:sqlstring}, '')::smallint AND d.start_address_id IN (SELECT id FROM addr)
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'drive', d.id, d.end_date, d.end_address_id
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.car_id = NULLIF(${selected_car_id:sqlstring}, '')::smallint AND d.end_address_id IN (SELECT id FROM addr)
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'charge', cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.address_id
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.car_id = NULLIF(${selected_car_id:sqlstring}, '')::smallint AND cp.address_id IN (SELECT id FROM addr)
    AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date)
)
SELECT to_char((timezone('UTC', min(v.ts)) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')               AS "Date",
       min(v.ts)                                                 AS "First seen",
       max(v.ts)                                                 AS "Last seen",
       count(DISTINCT v.ref_id) FILTER (WHERE v.kind = 'drive')  AS "Drives",
       count(DISTINCT v.ref_id) FILTER (WHERE v.kind = 'charge') AS "Charges",
       string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(a.name, nullif(concat_ws(' ', a.road, a.house_number), ''),
                                    split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)), ' · ') AS "Places",
       (extract(epoch FROM date_trunc('day', timezone('UTC', min(v.ts)), '$__timezone')) * 1000)::bigint                       AS day_from,
       (extract(epoch FROM (((timezone('UTC', min(v.ts)) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')) * 1000)::bigint - 1 AS day_to
FROM visits v
JOIN addr a ON a.id = v.address_id
GROUP BY (timezone('UTC', v.ts) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')::date
ORDER BY min(v.ts) DESC

panels.title: 所选地点的到访日

list.definition:
SELECT
    id as __value,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(id) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(name, ' - ', RIGHT(vin, 6)) ELSE COALESCE(name, CONCAT('VIN ', vin)) end as __text 
FROM cars
ORDER BY display_priority ASC, name ASC, vin ASC;
